title: Biotin Supplements
subtitle: Evidence, dosing, safety, interactions, and practical considerations for biotin supplements.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports biotin's metabolic role and use in deficiency states. Moderate and emerging evidence exists for its roles in cosmetic and other health benefits. Evidence for safety is robust though laboratory interference is a well-documented clinical concern. Limitations include gaps in large-scale clinical trials for supplemental efficacy beyond deficiency treatment.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
